notes: Primary research article (JACS 2007), not retracted per record.json and no retraction notice in the PDF. Sorbents are zeolite-beta-templated, N-doped CVD carbons (CA800, CA850, CB850, CB850h) after HF removal of the template; commercial activated carbon G212 (1405 m2/g) was also measured (SI Figure 5S). H2 uptake measured gravimetrically (Hiden IGA-003, -196 °C, 0-20 bar, buoyancy-corrected) and volumetrically for CA850 (ASAP 2020, 0-1.1 bar, -196 °C). Table 1 'max H2 uptake' values are Langmuir-fit estimates (fitted_extrapolated), not measured points. Isotherms at -186 °C for CB850h appear in SI Figure 7S. The paper cites earlier uptake on different zeolite-templated carbons (ref 9) but does not state that any value here was published before, so duplicate_data does not apply.
